title: C.E. 2471.166 — forty-three seconds
notes: Episode 42. Both ends have revoked the standing quorum, so the gate cannot open automatically and nothing overrides that. Nina binds a hundred and twenty-five discarded ledgers into a temporary causal proof and holds the coolant valve by hand. Forty-seven children, nineteen wounded, the third ledger's original and ARK-2's navigation core go through in forty-three seconds. The door opens. The record forks at both ends forever, the method cannot be used twice, and the act is filed as cause unassigned — which is why the survivors write her name by hand.
